node.statement: If j is in U and k is in V, then j and k lie in distinct equivalence classes because U and V are disjoint unions sharing no class. Thus j not~k and, by symmetry, k not~j. By the defining biconditional for ~, dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}!=1 and dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}!=1. This does not imply either dimension is zero: excluding dimensions at least two requires the separate one-dimensional-corner-dimension theorem, which is not an allowed external input in this workspace.
